description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Safehold Elite
When Safehold Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Safehold Elite enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Safehold Elite
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
